question: For each transformer pad shown, identify the likely access door orientation and measure the minimum distance in all directions (front, back, sides) to verify 10-foot clearance to buildings or open areas. Which transformer pads, if any, have less than 10 feet clearance on any side?
checklistItemText: Transformer pad hot-stick use area (access door side) lacks minimum 10-foot clearance to open area or adjacent building/structure
classifierReasoning: The agent is asking for distance measurements from transformer pad access doors to buildings/structures in all directions to verify the 10-foot clearance requirement, which is a direct clearance measurement task despite the multi-step framing.
